label: JZ Mock D · Paper 2 · Question 2
knowledgePattern: Combine linked logarithms without reversing their bases
solution:
The definitions give x=wx, y=xy and z=yz. Substitute in order: y=(wx)y=wxy and z=(wxy)z=wxyz.

Therefore logwz=xyz. Every base and argument is greater than 1, so all conversions are valid. Answer A.

hints.title: Turn each logarithm into a power
hints.body: Use logba=c to write a=bc. Apply this to each of the three given equations.
hints.recap: A logarithm tells you the power of its base.
hints.pitfall: Keep the base, the number after log, and the answer in the right places.

recall.reminder: A logarithm tells you the power of its base.

hints.title: Substitute from the last equation backwards
hints.body: Start with your equation for z. Replace its base using your equation for y, then replace x using your first equation.
hints.recap: When a power is raised to another power, multiply the two exponents.
hints.pitfall: Do not add the exponents in a power of a power.
hints.pause: Write z as a power of w, then read off the requested logarithm.
